$comment: Peakst8 Mattermost bootstrap manifest v2 (matrix). One team; channels prefixed by vertical or horizontal. Consumed by deploy/bootstrap.py. v1 (five flat entities) kept as channels.flat-v1.json.

team.name: peakst8
team.description: Single team. Entity separation is by channel prefix, not by team, so that search and cross-entity visibility work.

channels.name: company-announcements
channels.purpose: Leads post, everyone reads. Replies go in a thread, never in the channel.
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Broadcast only. Reply in thread.

channels.name: decisions
channels.purpose: Append-only decision log. One post per decision, same day, linked to its Notion page.
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | One post per decision. Do not discuss here, link the thread.

channels.name: weekly-digest
channels.purpose: Friday roll-up. One post per vertical and horizontal: what shipped, what is blocked, what was decided.
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Posted by each channel owner every Friday.

channels.name: ops-escalations
channels.purpose: Anything blocking an athlete, event or client today. Same-day issues only.
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Today-blocking issues only. Everything else goes to the vertical or horizontal channel.

channels.name: alert-systems
channels.purpose: Integrations, monitoring and uptime. Machine posts only, no discussion.
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Machine output only. Discuss in #tech-eng.

channels.name: calls
channels.purpose: Brand and customer call summaries from Bluedot. Full transcripts live in the Notion Calls database.
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Bot posts only. Discuss in the call's project or vertical channel.

channels.name: random
channels.header: No owner. No purpose. That is the point.

channels.name: finance
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Restricted membership. Private by stated reason: commercial.

channels.name: people
channels.header: Owner: @{owner} | Restricted membership. Private by stated reason: personal data.

on_demand_conventions.$comment: NOT created at bootstrap. One seed example each is created so the convention is visible.

project.rule: One per initiative. Time-boxed. Archived on close, never deleted.

external.rule: One per partner per entity. Guests only see this channel. A supplier working two entities gets two channels, never one shared.
external.note: Guests need a Professional license. The seed channel is created now; guests are invited only after the license is applied.

post_create_rules: Every channel must have a non-empty purpose and header before anyone is invited.
A channel with an empty purpose is archived at the monthly review.
Default to public. A private channel requires a stated reason in its header.

vertical_channel_template.purpose: {Name} home channel. Anything that is not ops or GTM starts here.
{Name} delivery and on-ground operations. Written standup posts here.
vertical_channel_template.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Standup by 10:30: doing / blocked / needs a decision.

tech.purpose: Tech home channel. Requests into tech start here.
tech.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Requests into tech start here.

sales.purpose: Sales home channel across every vertical.
sales.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Cross-vertical sales. Vertical-specific deals go in #{vertical}-gtm.

sales.purpose: Pipeline, sponsorship packaging and pricing shared across verticals.
sales.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Pipeline and packaging. Commercial terms stay in #finance.

community.purpose: Community home channel: athletes, clubs, ambassadors, content.
Social, newsletters and athlete stories for every vertical.
community.header: Owner: @{owner} | Docs: {docs} | Content calendar and approvals.

owners.$comment: Mattermost usernames. Fill in as champions are named; re-run bootstrap.py to update headers. TBD renders as 'Owner: @TBD'.

docs.$comment: Notion URLs, filled once the workspace exists. Empty renders as 'Docs: (coming)'.
